method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Macroscelididae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (3 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only macroscelidids are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

sources.role: Official inclusion list; English and Afrikaans species names; species order; absence of asterisk status flags on Macroscelididae; printed English spelling Short-shouted elephant-shrew
Research-grade species counts for Macroscelididae in Kruger (place 69020); 3 species in this pull (Elephantulus myurus, 15; Petrodromus tetradactylus, 15; Elephantulus brachyrhynchus, 2)
All-grade Macroscelididae taxonomy tree for place 69020; used to confirm the three official species and to find subspecies identifications Petrodromus tetradactylus schwanni
Not required for the official species: all three were present in species_counts
Current name lists for the three official species; the 2011 scientific names are unchanged

remaps.note: iNaturalist preferred_common_name for taxon 43226. Four-toed Elephant Shrew, Four-toed Elephant-shrew and Forest Elephant Shrew remain listed English names on the same taxon. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name.

iNaturalist preferred_common_name for taxon 43211. Short-snouted Elephant Shrew and Short-snouted Elephant-shrew remain listed English names on the same taxon. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name, including the printed spelling 'Short-shouted'.

notes: The 2011 checklist prints the English name as 'Short-shouted elephant-shrew'. The stored en value follows that spelling and was not silently corrected.

remaps.note: iNaturalist preferred_common_name for taxon 43213. Eastern Rock Elephant Shrew remains a listed English name on the same taxon. The stored en value is the 2011 SANParks checklist name.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).
Subspecies identifications of the included species (Petrodromus tetradactylus schwanni) were not treated as a separate candidate, because the 2011 list is at species rank.

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Macroscelididae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
